facts.fact: CMS says Act 09-08 and its implementing decree set the roles of the Moroccan data protection authority, the CNDP, whose members' identity was published in the Official Gazette starting a two-year compliance period ending 15 November 2012; the document gives no other date, so the published date is used.
facts.system: Commission Nationale de contrôle de la protection des données à caractère personnel (CNDP)

note: carried from dataprotectionauthority; no document opened
